us_upstream_const.coal_mine_methane_kg_p.design: DESIGN 13.6 (owner decision, round 2): coal upstream, methane-only term
us_upstream_const.coal_mine_methane_kg_p.formula: F_COAL = round12(epa_ghgi.2022.coal_mining_ch4_total (MMT CO2e) x us_upstream_const.kg_per_million_metric_tons / (eia.2022.coal_production_short_tons (thousand short tons) x us_upstream_const.short_tons_per_thousand_short_tons x eia.2022.coal_heat_content_production (MMBtu/short ton, HHV))) kg CO2e per MMBtu HHV

inputs.unit: MMT CO2e (million metric tons CO2-equivalent; IPCC AR5 100-year GWPs), calendar year 2022
inputs.locator: Table 3-1 'CO2, CH4, and N2O Emissions from Energy (MMT CO2 Eq.)', pp. 3-4 to 3-5, CH4 block, row 'Coal Mining', column 2022 (last column)

inputs.unit: thousand short tons (calendar year 2022 U.S. coal production)
inputs.locator: Table 6.1 Coal Overview (Thousand Short Tons), annual row '2022 Total', column 'Production' (first numeric column, footnote a)

inputs.unit: MMBtu per short ton (gross heat content, HHV; coal production 2022)
inputs.locator: Table A5 (Million Btu per Short Ton), row 2022, column 'Coal Production' (first numeric column, footnote a)

us_upstream_const.coal_mine_methane_kg_p.gwpSet: IPCC AR5 100-year (EPA GHGI CO2 Eq. values; the CH4 GWP number itself is not printed in the text read)
us_upstream_const.coal_mine_methane_kg_p.heatingValue: HHV (EIA gross heat content), matching the eGRID heat input basis
us_upstream_const.coal_mine_methane_kg_p.boundary: Coal mine methane only (active underground mines net of recovery and use, surface mines, post-mining); excludes abandoned mines, mining energy CO2 and coal transport CO2; all U.S. coal production including exports, not only power-plant coal

us_upstream_const.ng_upstream_distributi.formula: netl2024_4862.ng_upstream.prod_through_distribution (g CO2e/MJ HHV) x us_upstream_const.mj_per_mmbtu / 1000 (exact, no rounding)

us_upstream_const.ng_upstream_transmissi.formula: netl2024_4862.ng_upstream.prod_through_transmission (g CO2e/MJ HHV) x us_upstream_const.mj_per_mmbtu / 1000 (exact, no rounding)
